records.text: A Pasty George writes: "At first I did not like CK because he denied all the horrible things going on in the Middle East. However, after he was gone, I started to watch his videos, and I saw the ones where he started to question and doubt the ones that he was standing up for. JFK asked too many questions as well. I cannot say to you enough: I get what you are saying."
records.speaker: Candace Owens
